comment: src/Accessor.cpp at commit b90cd69, with the expander protocol in src/DMA.hpp. As with DMA-FX the host is taken from rightExpander (DMA.hpp line 267), so this module sits to the LEFT of the module it reaches into. The data output carries whatever was stored, so it has no range of its own; on a memory of true and false values it reads 1V and 0V. Trigger mode was added in commit c280fab, before the 2.8.1 version bump, so it is in the installed build. The write switch's own choices are named 'when gate active', 'always' and 'on trigger' in the source; the panel prints only Write. The channel knob runs to 16 while no host yet offers that many channels, so values above the host's count light the lamp red and stop the module working. The panel prints CHANNEL, Address, Data and Write.
